behavioral strings and booleans, including stop and Core execution contracts, are retained
units use a finite curated field contract after camelCase normalization, with explicit known, unknown, and not-applicable status
selected and omitted views are machine-readable and semantic coverage remains partial
CLI read failures use the same versioned report envelope as API failures
invalid projections clear admitted views and all top-level or nested provisional mappings
accepted_claims: persisted aircraft Business v1 and Core v2 can be independently reloaded and projected without a hidden canonical object

an independently edited valid Core remains reviewable without reconstructing its original Business template
only a complete verified raw bundle and compiler-lineage/v2 publish cross-layer Plan mappings
stable Business IDs and qualified Core symbols remain identities while Plan paths remain revision-specific locators
coarse compatibility operations remain named, versioned, and partial rather than being presented as rule-level or execution equivalence
real persisted B1 and F35 artifacts exercise entities, processes, predecessors, resources, states, rules, parameters, units, provenance, and mappings
remaining_limits: remote exact-head CI has not yet been run or read back for this slice

production and ABM artifacts are isolated and unsupported by this aircraft review schema
